brief:
Israeli affairs analyst Adel Shidid told Shehab Wire that the FlyDubai plane incident that occurred yesterday remains in its early stages, with significant domestic and international repercussions expected to follow in coming weeks.

Shidid assessed that Prime Minister Netanyahu intends to convert the incident into electoral material as political pressure mounts on his government amid ongoing conflicts and security challenges.
